entry.title: Black Friday, Cyber Monday shopping projected to slip
entry.summary: Shoppers will scoop up deals during Thanksgiving weekend, but extended sales events have enticed consumers to start holiday shopping early, according to the National Retail Federation.

entry.title: The wonder and ritual of Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade
entry.summary: It’s one of the oldest and last remaining monoculture moments in the U.S., and it tells a deeply American story about immigrants, retail, heritage and the power of pageantry.

entry.title: Retailers brace for Black Friday after widespread tech outages
entry.summary: The vital shopping event and Cyber Week already pose a challenge to retailers’ online systems — but the recent spate of outages across sectors highlights a new set of hurdles.

entry.title: Dollar Tree predicts holiday shoppers will ‘buy closer to need’
entry.summary: The retailer’s Q3 total revenue grew nearly 7%, with traffic growth outpacing increases in average ticket.

entry.title: Kohl’s turns a corner in Q3, no thanks to Sephora
entry.summary: The department store posted positive comps in most categories, thanks to strong private label sales and store improvements, and profits soared.

entry.title: Nike ‘absolutely making the right decision with Jordan’: Dick’s Sporting Goods
entry.summary: Executive Chairman Edward Stack applauded Nike for its long-term approach with the brand, as Foot Locker sees some signs of progress.

entry.title: Holiday marketing hits inflection point in 2026: What brands need to know
entry.summary: Consumers’ push-pull relationship with buzzy tactics like AI and tried-and-true strategies like creator tie-ups is challenging brands to find the right balance.

entry.title: Shoe Station flip flops on rebanner plan, again
entry.summary: Most of the rebannered Shoe Station stores will become Shoe Carnival stores once more, the company said.

entry.title: Shein to pay $100M in FTC settlement over deceptive practices claims
entry.summary: The e-commerce company faced allegations from the federal agency over its fast shipping promises, the way it posted product reviews online and more.

entry.title: ‘Heartbroken’: Macy’s 100th Thanksgiving Day parade postponed
entry.summary: The retailer’s iconic New York City event has moved to Saturday due to inclement weather. The 100th iteration has been worked on for about five years.
